args.subject: Open lines on HPO-26-00623 and HPO-26-00554 after the cyberattack
args.body:
Dear Zhou Hui,

Thank you for your 19 September update on the cyberattack and the new dates. We are glad production is running. Please confirm that the new dates below still hold now that your systems are being restored, and give us dates for the two lines that have none.

Five lines are in this email. Three were already past due on 25 September (marked below).

New dates to confirm:
- HPO-26-00623/10 · Harness, lidar power and ethernet (HR-21107) · 890 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October
- HPO-26-00623/20 · Harness, main distribution (HR-21111) · 115 EA · promised 24 September, now 20 November (past due)
- HPO-26-00623/30 · Harness, fork actuator and sensors (HR-21112) · 270 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October

Dates needed, no new date given yet:
- HPO-26-00554/30 · Harness, drive motor power and hall (HR-21109) · 280 EA · promised 24 September (past due)
- HPO-26-00554/40 · Harness, battery 48 V (HR-21110) · 13 EA · promised 21 September (past due)

Please reply by 9 October.

Nothing in this email accepts the notice or waives any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
